To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effect of diversifications on firm performance is different in falling and growing economies.
diversification is more likely to be beneficial in the falling economy.
the value of product diversification in the falling economy is significantly higher than the value of diversification in the growing economy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of corporate product diversification on performance in the context of different national economic dynamics in Russia and China.
the effect of corporate product diversification on the value creation in emerging economies.
the value creation effect of product diversifcation in the context of falling and rising national economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the value creation effect of product diversifications varies depending on the type of the national economy dynamics: if a national economy is growing, diversification strategy is not a value enhancing instrument while in a falling economy diversification creates value.

the value creation effect of diversification varies depending on the national economy dynamics. If the national economy is not falling product diversification does not create value while if the economy is falling product diversity can be beneficial for a firm.
the effect of diversifying across industries is not the same in all emerging markets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the value and benefits of diversification are different depending on the national economic conditions.
diversification is not always a value creating strategy and the effect of diversifying depends on the economic environment of the home country.
the diversification performance is different depending on the state (rising or falling) of the economy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of diversifcation on firm performance is not constant and varies depending on the state (growth or recession) of a national economy.
the effect of corporate product diversification on the performance of firms in emerging markets is not universal but depends on the type of the national economy dynamics.
the diversification strategy is beneficial in the case of the falling economy and harmful in the case of rising economy.
